ProcessValues provides the MTP-Interface and the number of values of each type of process in/out value
and calls the FB for each analog, digital, binary and string process in/out value which is not mapped to any service
Transfer whole UDT from Ext to MTP for not mapped (to a service) process values out
Call of process value FB for each not mapped analog in value
without this trick, the compiler throws error division by zero
Number_Mapped + Number_not_Mapped = Number_Total
Call FB only in case that the values of the constants are consistent and that no division by zero is possible
Not-mapped (to a service) process values in are located at upper MTP-indices and must be mapped to their external output area
